author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Learn how to paint a straight line without painter’s tape and save time on your next DIY painting project. Trust me, I've been painting homes professionally for over 30 years. In this video, I show you why you don’t always need tape to get crisp paint lines, clean edges, and professional-looking results when painting walls, trim, baseboards, outlets, and corners.

If you’ve ever wondered how to cut in paint by hand, how to paint trim without tape, how to paint baseboards, or whether painter’s tape is actually worth it, this quick painting tip will help. Painter’s tape can be useful in some situations, but for most homeowners, learning how to use a paint brush properly is faster, cheaper, and often gives you better control.

The trick is simple: don’t press too hard, load your brush properly, set the brush where you want the line, and drag it smoothly along the edge. Whether you’re painting a room, painting walls, cutting in around trim, or trying to get a clean line between your wall
title: Stop Taping Before You Paint
